name: Sranan Gold Corp.
summary: Sranan Gold Corp. is engaged in the development, acquisition, and exploration of mineral properties across Canada, primarily concentrating on gold deposits. The company's most significant asset is the Tapanahony Gold project, located in Suriname. Founded in 2021, the firm was formerly known as Peak Minerals Ltd. before rebranding to Sranan Gold Corp. in April 2025. Its operational base is situated in Edmonton, Canada.
